method: Static named/local/import/namespace/reexport call reachability, stopping traversal at named task transaction callback barriers. Conservative nested callbacks; excludes assigned aliases, export-star/object dispatch, shadowing resolution and dynamic calls. Discovery only; source review and faults required.

reviewed.recordCheck: Resolves an omitted task ID from schema/semantic-validated state before wrapping state, receipt and ledger writes in withTaskTransaction. Absent state reaches prerequisite refusal, not an accepted mutation.
reviewed.rebindCompletionRejectionSnapshot: Reuses getTaskTransaction when present; otherwise reads selected state and opens withTaskTransaction using its validated task ID.
reviewed.authorizeCompletionRecoveryOrRebind: Delegates its mutation to the reviewed rebind wrapper.
reviewed.recordTerminalResult: Reads selected state and invokes withTaskTransaction before its mutation implementation.

existingTestScope: storage-record-check-atomicity covers receipt/event fault rollback for command, direct API and direct canonical-path entries; presence inspection is not a new test execution.
limitations: Static scan excludes assigned aliases, export-star/object dispatch, scope-shadowing resolution and dynamic calls.
A conditional transaction-context branch is not recognized by this scan and must be reviewed directly.
Other multi-write candidates and external subprocess effects remain outside this bounded disposition.
